# Introduction

Frame the paper around the management challenge of developing regeneration in
multiaged redwood stands while characterizing fuel conditions relevant to fire
adapted ecosystems. Draw selectively from the thesis introduction: retain the
silvicultural basis for overstory retention and redwood/tanoak regeneration;
compress general background that does not advance the study question.

End with focused objectives and expectations for regeneration and the fuel
reference dataset. Refine wording only after the publication analyses are
specified.
